rationale: Artem's deep expertise in ML systems, efficient inference, and computer vision aligns directly with David's conviction that ML infrastructure burden for production robotics is vastly underestimated—and his hands-on experience shipping PyTorch/MLX implementations could unlock real-time perception challenges at LiveKit's robotics stack. David's decade building autonomous systems (drones, tractors) and purpose-built real-time infrastructure pairs well with Artem's open-source VLM and transformer work, creating a natural skill exchange around edge inference and production-grade computer vision.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet David Chen — your ML systems and vision-language model expertise could directly address the inference and observability gaps David is tackling with LiveKit's real-time robotics infrastructure.
